method: Separate original Cocos and improved converted-engine playthroughs. Same logical first four moves. Real browser input and rendered pixels, normal speed, no fabricated state, no generated gameplay. Updated runtime audio only.

original.method: Authentic gameplay canvases composited at matching CSS framing and captured by MediaRecorder at normal speed. Timed physical pointer drags; normal asynchronous startup; no state injection, teleports, time stepping, frame interpolation, or substituted concept art. DOM preference buttons outside canvases omitted.
